name: nomos-conformance-runner
description: Conformance harness for Nomos analyzers (ROADMAP stage 1).

scripts.go: go build -C ../../analyzers/go -o bin/nomos-go.exe ./cmd/nomos-go && node src/cli.ts run --analyzer "go=analyzers/go/bin/nomos-go.exe"
scripts.typescript: node src/cli.ts run --analyzer "typescript=node analyzers/typescript/src/main.ts" --analyzer "javascript=node analyzers/typescript/src/main.ts --language javascript"
scripts.all: dotnet build ../../analyzers/csharp/Nomos.slnx -v q && go build -C ../../analyzers/go -o bin/nomos-go.exe ./cmd/nomos-go && node src/cli.ts run --analyzer "csharp=dotnet analyzers/csharp/src/Nomos.Analyzer.CSharp/bin/Debug/net10.0/nomos-csharp.dll" --analyzer "go=analyzers/go/bin/nomos-go.exe" --analyzer "typescript=node analyzers/typescript/src/main.ts" --analyzer "javascript=node analyzers/typescript/src/main.ts --language javascript" --analyzer "python=node analyzers/python/run.mjs" --analyzer "java=node analyzers/java/run.mjs" --analyzer "kotlin=node analyzers/kotlin/run.mjs" --analyzer "ruby=node analyzers/ruby/run.mjs"
